description: Tasks and debug sessions light a lane on Desk Arcade's scoreboard while you play, and a status-bar button shows or hides the game overlay.
config.tasks.enabled: Light a lane on the scoreboard for each task that runs a process: build, test, anything in tasks.json. Background tasks, such as watchers, never do.
config.tasks.which: Which tasks light a lane on the scoreboard.
config.tasks.which.buildAndTest: Only tasks in the build and test groups
config.debug.enabled: Light a lane on the scoreboard for each debug session.
config.lanePrefix: Text put before the name of each lane on the scoreboard, for example `VS Code · `. `${folder}` becomes the workspace folder's name, so `${folder} · ` gives `api · build`.
config.statusBar: Show the Desk Arcade button in the status bar.
config.profile: The `--profile` name of the Desk Arcade copy to talk to. Leave it empty for the usual one.
config.programPath: Where Desk Arcade is, if it is not in the usual place (an AppImage, for example). It is used only to start Desk Arcade from **Show or hide the overlay**, **Next game** and **Play while it builds** when it is not running; tasks and debug sessions never start it.
